posts.title: Intellectual Obesity
posts.description: Intellectual Obesity is overconsumption without Action. Organizing your information is digestion. Retrieving your knowledge is absorption. Acting on your knowledge is growth. If you never Organize nor Retrieve, you may be full of shit without knowing it.
